The positive cases are mostly peace-process and ceasefire diplomacy, while the domestic record on protests, activists, journalists, prisons, and emergency-style governance is predominantly coercive.","evidence":[{"title":"Congo police break up small protest over parliamentary election results","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-16","url":"https://www.kelo.com/2024/01/16/congo-police-break-up-small-protest-over-parliamentary-election-results/","summary":"Police dispersed a Kinshasa protest, beating some participants and arresting others.
